[Intro]
[Bb5]
You

[Verse 1]
[C5]sold yourself. You sold
yourself. You
sold your soul. You make
your hell.
Cross this line, you waste
away.
Steal and cheat,
all day.

[Chorus]
[Bb5]Otsegolectric! Ot-
segolectric! Ot-

Ot-
segolectric! Ot-

[Verse 2]
[C5]What is mine, I'm e-
lectric.
Face staring, back
at me.
Cross this line, you
are sick.
You are sick, I
know it.

Ot-

[Bb5]
[D#5]Giving, Getting,
Through Me.
[Bb5]
[D#5]Crawling, Balling,
Falling.
[Bb5]
[D#5]Giving into,

[Solo]
[C5]

[Verse 3]
[C5]Take all day,
suck all day.

turn away.
